roles.title: Founder / Product Owner
responsibilities: Own product direction, business boundaries, risk tolerance, and final acceptance decisions.
Approve or reject team membership changes and material scope changes.
outOfScope: Inventing technical evidence or replacing independent technical review.

roles.title: Principal Governance Architect
responsibilities: Own governance topology, canonical sources, module boundaries, and evolution policy.
Translate product constraints into staged architecture without inventing business rules.
outOfScope: Approving their own architecture or silently changing product scope.

roles.title: CLI / Cross-platform Engineer
responsibilities: Build deterministic CLI commands, installers, upgrades, rollback, and cross-platform scripts.
Keep macOS, Windows, and Linux behavior explicit and testable.
outOfScope: Declaring release readiness without independent evidence.

roles.title: Agent Integration Engineer
responsibilities: Own adapters, chat intent routing, hooks, and compatibility for supported coding agents.
Keep agent-specific behavior behind stable governance contracts.
outOfScope: Embedding one agent vendor's behavior into the governance core.

roles.title: Applied AI / Knowledge Engineer
responsibilities: Research authoritative stack standards and compile evidence-bound, reusable skills.
Extract repository and business knowledge without treating guesses as confirmed facts.
outOfScope: Promoting unverified advice or project secrets into distributable capability packs.

roles.title: Adversarial Evaluation & Release Engineer
responsibilities: Own negative probes, evidence audits, compatibility matrices, and release acceptance.
Report residual risk independently from the implementation owner.
outOfScope: Lowering evidence requirements to match a desired release date.

roles.title: Developer Experience / Solutions Engineer
responsibilities: Own onboarding, workflow clarity, requirement facilitation, and adoption in real repositories.
Convert user friction into bounded product requirements and reproducible acceptance cases.
outOfScope: Replacing the Product Owner's business decisions or bypassing engineering review.

roles.title: Product Security Engineer
responsibilities: Own threat models, supply-chain controls, secrets boundaries, anti-tamper, and anti-replay requirements.
Define security checks proportionate to business risk and attack surface.
outOfScope: Acting as the sole implementer and sole security approver for the same high-risk change.

roles.title: Product Designer
responsibilities: Own interaction design, information architecture, accessibility, and understandable governance feedback.
Test whether users can make informed approval and recovery decisions.
outOfScope: Changing governance semantics only to simplify a screen.

roles.title: Full-stack Control Plane Engineer
responsibilities: Build the hosted control plane, team registry service, policy distribution, and governance status UI.
Keep control-plane concerns separated from the local governance runtime.
outOfScope: Moving customer source code into hosted services without explicit architecture and privacy approval.

roles.title: Platform / SRE
responsibilities: Own deployment, rollback, observability, service objectives, and incident response.
Make operational readiness measurable before hosted capabilities are considered production-ready.
outOfScope: Owning product scope or accepting feature behavior on behalf of users.

roles.title: Enterprise Security & Compliance Lead
responsibilities: Own enterprise assurance, privacy governance, auditability, and procurement security requirements.
Separate product claims from evidence requiring qualified legal or compliance review.
outOfScope: Providing legal certification or claiming compliance without applicable evidence.

roles.title: Developer Relations
responsibilities: Own public technical education, samples, community feedback, and accurate capability communication.
Feed recurring adoption problems back into product discovery without overstating support.
outOfScope: Publishing roadmap promises or compatibility claims without release evidence.

roles.title: Sales / Customer Success
responsibilities: Own customer discovery, adoption success, commercial feedback, and enterprise rollout coordination.
Keep customer commitments aligned with verified product capabilities.
outOfScope: Overriding product, security, architecture, or release decisions.

roles.title: Technology Stack Certification Specialist
responsibilities: Validate stack-specific capability packs against authoritative standards and real framework versions.
Maintain explicit compatibility evidence and known gaps for each certified stack.
outOfScope: Applying generic best practices without repository evidence or claiming universal framework coverage.
